messages.content: I need all pending and active mandates of users parath and bhanu

function.name: user_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a user based on the provided user name and the status of the mandates. This API is intended for use by partners to retrieve information about their clients' mandates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the partner's client for whom to fetch mandates.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched.

function.name: partner_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a partner based on the specified status. If no status is provided, all mandates are retrieved. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If left empty, mandates with any status will be retrieved.

message.reasoning:
We need to call user_mandates twice? Actually we need all pending and active mandates of users parath and bhanu. So we need to fetch mandates for each user with status pending or active. We can call user_mandates twice: once for parath, once for bhanu. But we need both statuses. The function signature allows status optional; default active. We can pass status "active" or "pending". But we want both. We could call twice per user: one for active, one for pending. Or maybe we can call with status unspecified to get active only. But we need both. So we need two calls per user. That is four calls. But maybe we can combine? The function only accepts one status. So we need separate calls.

Thus we should call user_mandates({"name":"parath","status":"active"}) and user_mandates({"name":"parath","status":"pending"}). Similarly for bhanu.

We need to output the results. We'll call the function four times. Let's do it.
